description: This file defines an interface for a grain in Orleans, specifically for a consumer that handles multiple stream subscriptions. It includes method signatures for managing stream subscriptions, resuming, stopping, and retrieving subscription details.

classes.name: IMultipleSubscriptionConsumerGrain
classes.description: An Orleans grain interface for a consumer that manages multiple stream subscriptions, allowing to become a consumer, resume, stop, and query subscriptions.

methods.name: BecomeConsumer
methods.description: Subscribes the grain as a consumer to a specified stream identified by streamId and streamNamespace, using a specified provider.

methods.name: Resume
methods.description: Resumes a previously paused or inactive subscription handle.

methods.name: StopConsuming
methods.description: Stops the consumption of a specified subscription handle.

methods.name: GetAllSubscriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all subscription handles for a given stream identified by streamId and streamNamespace.

methods.name: GetNumberConsumed
methods.description: Returns a dictionary mapping subscription handles to the number of items consumed.

methods.name: ClearNumberConsumed
methods.description: Clears the record of the number of items consumed.
